item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.8 (build 813) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic for Mac 0.3.8 (beta)

Download

CedarLogic-0.3.8-Mac.dmg below: open it and drag CedarLogic into Applications. macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon. The first time you open it, macOS may ask you to confirm: open System Settings › Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.

What's new

  • Link this Mac to your sync by scanning, no typing. Settings › Sync › I Have a Code now shows a QR code. On a phone that syncs, open CedarLogic › Your Circuits › Sync › Add a Device and scan it: the phone sends this Mac your sync code (end-to-end encrypted), and you press Link. Typing or pasting the code still works too.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.7 (build 802) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic 0.3.7

  • Sync Your Circuits across your devices. Settings › Sync › Turn On Sync gives you a sync code (and a QR code). Enter it on your other Mac, your Raspberry Pi, your Windows PC or CedarLogic Online on your phone, and your circuits follow you. They're end-to-end encrypted: the website stores them but can't read them.
  • When two devices change the same circuit, nothing is lost: the newer one becomes the circuit and the other is kept in Version History.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.6 (build 779) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic 0.3.6

  • Full Rearrange is fast again: big pages tidy in about a second instead of half a minute, with fewer bends and crossings.
  • Lab reports: a heading always stays with what's under it, and a long list of labels stays a tidy list.
  • Truth tables: a FROM label or a ground no longer makes a page look like it has clocks or flip-flops.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.5 (build 769) beta
item.description:
CedarLogic 0.3.5

  • Check My Circuit (⇧T): type the formula or truth table your assignment asks for, and CedarLogic tells you whether your circuit matches, with the wrong rows in red.
  • Export Lab Report: File › Export Lab Report… makes one PDF with your name, the circuit, its truth table, Karnaugh maps and the timing diagram.
  • Share Link: File › Share Link… copies a link that opens your circuit in CedarLogic Online. Links from the website can open straight in the app.
  • A smarter Full Rearrange: Tidy Up keeps groups of parts together, keeps your labels in order and runs straight wires straight.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.4 (build 758)
item.description:
CedarLogic 0.3.4

  • Build from Formula, NOR only: a negated product such as (AB)' is now built correctly. Before, it came out as a single NOR gate, (A + B)', so the circuit didn't match the formula.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.3 (build 756)
item.description:
• Fixed a crash that could happen when you placed a saved part (My Parts) whose wires ran to something you hadn't selected when you saved it.
  • Panels like Add a Gate and a part's settings now close when you click off them.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.2 (build 755)
item.description:
• The welcome (and What's New after an update) now comes in on top of your circuit instead of hiding behind it.
  • The disk image always shows the Applications folder next to CedarLogic.

item.title: CedarLogic 0.3.1 (build 754)
item.description:
CedarLogic 0.3.1 for Mac

  • A new disk image: CedarLogic and Applications side by side, with the arrow between them.
  • The very first time CedarLogic opens, it plays a short sound of its own while the launch screen fills, then fades into the welcome.
  • Credits in About CedarLogic: CedarLogic began at Cedarville University and was modernized and brought to the Mac by Kieran Klukas; this version was rebuilt and extended with Claude.

Everything new in 0.3 (Your Circuits, templates, My Parts, Karnaugh maps and more) is in Help › What's New in CedarLogic.
